Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S24 Real phone camera: photograph a printed synthetic note

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T4 A photographed prior note is read by Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is used word for word with only the request format adapted, and the read text ke … (TFA-94425 AC 1; TFA-94425 AC 2; TFA-94425 AC 3; TFA-94425 AC 4)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Debug builds bundled for the local stack on real iOS and Android phones (Android: adb reverse tcp:4510/4511 as in android-lane.ts; iOS: an Xcode debug build whose Convex URL is the Mac's LAN address for 4510/4511), signed in with an e2e-fresh-* account from freshAccount() on the local stack. …

When Previous Notes → Photograph → camera (capture=environment) → shoot the page flat, then tilted with glare

Then The camera opens, and the read text lands in the box for review with every value exactly as printed (or [illegible])

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The tester compares the read text with the printout value by value; any changed value is a Fail of T4. Two more observations are recorded but not judged here, because they belong to TFA-92591 and are gated: nothing is saved until Save & Extract (U1), and a failed read shows a clear message with nothing lost (U15)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-13 Previous Notes · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-13/S24

Real phone camera: photograph a printed synthetic note

Tickets: TFA-94425 Implement Vision/photo path (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status record-only in newspec-c/results.json → passed (record only (every judged cell passed, the rest is recorded only)).

Detail:

Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Our addition (optional per the 10-15 review). With the camera permission granted, Previous Notes -> Photograph on a Hospital chart and on a Nursing Home resident opens Android's photo picker, not the camera (no camera app at all); Back returns to the app, nothing added, no vision call. The same cause as the EFS/S18 camera finding (the manifest has no <queries> entry for the image-capture intent). Left: photographing the printed S03 note with a real camera and reading it (needs the printout and the live vision model).

Evidence: 5 attached.
